objective: Blindly discover concrete lexical source words that are disproportionately concentrated in preregistered document/row/numeric-block structural roles and reproduce that concentration on heldout documents.

roles.DOCUMENT_HEADER: first lexical source word in a mechanically parsed document
roles.DOCUMENT_CLOSER: last lexical source word in a mechanically parsed document
roles.ROW_HEADER: first lexical source word among words assigned unambiguously to the same source row
roles.ROW_CLOSER: last lexical source word among words assigned unambiguously to the same source row
roles.NUMERIC_BLOCK_INTRODUCER: lexical source word immediately before a contiguous run of at least two exact numeric-only source words
roles.NUMERIC_BLOCK_CLOSER: lexical source word immediately after a contiguous run of at least two exact numeric-only source words

role_domains.DOCUMENT_HEADER: all lexical source-word occurrences in document
role_domains.DOCUMENT_CLOSER: all lexical source-word occurrences in document
role_domains.ROW_HEADER: all lexical occurrences with exactly one source row assignment
role_domains.ROW_CLOSER: all lexical occurrences with exactly one source row assignment
role_domains.NUMERIC_BLOCK_INTRODUCER: all lexical source-word occurrences in document
role_domains.NUMERIC_BLOCK_CLOSER: all lexical source-word occurrences in document

heldout_candidate_gate.null: cross-fitted Poisson-binomial upper tail; every heldout eligible occurrence uses the corresponding train fold role-background probability for the same preregistered role

positive_ladder.R7_C1: unchanged candidate survives full region holdout where support permits
positive_ladder.R7_C2: candidate advantage collapses under structure-destroying position/order null
positive_ladder.R7_C3: probable positional functional-role candidate may be admitted; exact lexical meaning and translation remain forbidden
positive_ladder.EXTERNAL: independent editorial source required before external replication credit

allowed: source word disproportionately concentrated in a preregistered document/row/numeric-block structural role
forbidden: probable function before R7-C1 and R7-C2
